tools.name: aegis_scan
tools.description: Call before editing files: returns the rules for `files` (default: the git diff), ranked by fitness within the token budget, and records this session's scan and rule exposure. Mandatory rules (gates, invariants) take at most two slots (the excess is in `omitted_mandatory`) and are served from the reviewed base, so branch-local edits to them do not bind and are listed in `unreviewed_rules`. Use `aegis_list_rules` to browse without recording and `aegis_report_outcome` after verifying. Fails closed if a rule file cannot be loaded.

files.description: Paths you are about to edit; omitted or empty means the files changed in the git work tree and index.

view.description: 'full' (default), 'summary' (key fields, lists capped at 10 plus <list>_count) or 'ids'.

tools.name: aegis_report_outcome
tools.description: Call after verifying a change with tests or `aegis check`, naming rules from `aegis_scan`; use `aegis_capture_insight` for user corrections. With a passing `aegis check --record --tests` row for the current tree, the rules this session's scans exposed that match the diff are credited, counting once CI passes on the landing commit; without one, it writes at most one unwitnessed claim per session and tree, which earns no credit. Capped at 200 report rows per session and rate-limited to 5 calls per 60 seconds.

outcome.description: 'success', 'tp' and 'pass' claim a true positive (credited only after CI); the others read as a neutral trigger, never a false positive.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per report (scoped by host and session): a retry is a no-op; reuse with another outcome fails.

rules_used.description: Rule IDs from aegis_scan; credit comes from this session's scan exposure and the diff, not this list.

tests_passed.description: Accepted for compatibility; ignored, never stored.

rework_count.description: Accepted for compatibility; ignored, never stored.

notes.description: Accepted for compatibility; ignored, never stored.

files.description: Paths edited in this change, for scan-before-edit compliance only (at most one 'edit' event per report); never affects credit.

view.description: 'full' (default), 'summary' (key fields, lists capped at 10 plus <list>_count) or 'ids'.

tools.name: aegis_create_rule
tools.description: Builds a prompt for drafting a rule from `description`, with up to three active workspace rules (500 chars each) as examples; it writes nothing to disk. Save the result to `.aegis/rules/<type_dir>/<id>.md` as `instruction` says. Check `aegis_list_rules` for an existing rule first.

description.description: The defect, anti-pattern or invariant the rule should codify.

rule_type.description: Rule type, passed to the draft prompt as a hint.

domain.description: Domain hint for the draft prompt (security, correctness, efficiency, style, governance).

tools.name: aegis_list_rules
tools.description: Lists every rule with metadata and ledger fitness (`_error` if unloadable, `_expired: true` if retired), the `stale_rules` edited since the last `aegis sync`, and non-rule files under `.aegis/rules/` (`ignored`). Records no scan or exposure: call `aegis_scan` before editing files.

rule_type.description: Only rules and stale_rules of this type.

view.description: 'full' (default), 'summary' (key fields, lists capped at 10 plus <list>_count) or 'ids'.

tools.name: aegis_capture_insight
tools.description: Appends a user correction or preference to `~/.aegis/insights/` for rule curation; use `aegis_report_outcome` to report whether rules helped. Secrets are redacted, `quote` is cut to 300 characters and `paths` default to the dirty git paths. Agent captures stay at `level: 'suggestion'`: invisible to `aegis_scan`, never counted by `aegis rule insight review`, never upgraded. Capped at 50 captures per session and rate-limited to 5 calls per 60 seconds.

quote.description: The user's verbatim correction (1-1024 chars); secrets are redacted and 300 chars stored.

paths.description: Paths it applies to (psrc 'explicit'; at most 20 of 512 chars); default: up to 20 dirty git paths (psrc 'dirty').
